groupings.title: Discover FieldRobin
groupings.description: Public product facts, docs, pricing, OpenAPI, and SDK/CLI links. Public discovery does not access workspace data.

groupings.title: Integrate the API
groupings.description: Public REST /api/v1, OpenAPI, SDK methods, CLI commands, and when to use authenticated MCP tools.

groupings.title: Connect an agent
groupings.description: Connect a native OAuth-capable MCP client to one FieldRobin workspace over Streamable HTTP.

groupings.title: Authenticate
groupings.description: Register an OAuth client (Authorization Code + PKCE), choose MCP scopes, and handle step-up consent.

groupings.title: Use FieldRobin
groupings.description: Review customers, leads, jobs, schedules, invoices, and reports in a connected workspace; create customers or jobs only when requested and authorized.

groupings.title: Set up the FieldRobin plugin
groupings.description: Connect or reconnect FieldRobin and choose the workspace permissions needed for the task.
